items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: Archey was the trombone player. You know Archy? ... Jimmy Arche y. Freddy Johnson was the piano player. In other words -- and I hadn't belonged to the union up till then. So I had to go join the union when I went up to that job.

ctx.x: Oh, yes. Joe Garland. Who was the other saxophone player? Oh, Roy Eldridge's brother. What's
his name? Joe. Joe Eldridge. Manzje Johnson was the drummer. Ward Pinkeft. Langston Curl. Archey was the trombone player. You know Archy?
